materials: Use case: stylized-concept. Original full-colour 1993 DOS fantasy RPG DUNGEON MATERIAL ATLAS for World of Maxxia Upper Cistern. EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square texture cells, no gutters, text, labels, borders, scenery perspective or characters. Flat orthographic tiles entirely filled with their material. Read left-to-right: row1 (1) aged blue-grey limestone block wall with warm mortar, (2) damp moss-green cistern brick wall with old mineral stains, (3) dark stone waterworks wall crossed by old copper pipes and brass fastenings. Row2 (4) overhead irregular grey-green flagstone floor, (5) overhead dark fitted stone ceiling blocks with shallow carved ribs, (6) overhead iron drainage grating over very dark green water. Row3 (7) front-facing closed oak dungeon door with iron bands and stone jamb, (8) front-facing closed dark iron barred pump grate filling square with stone jamb and black gaps, (9) front-facing closed bronze archive door with round brass lock plate and narrow geometric decorative bands, no writing. Crisp realistic painted pixel clusters, dark green/blue masonry contrasted amber brass/copper, readable at128x128, restrained lighting for runtime shadows. Tile-like wall and floor edges. No modern neon, no UI, no isometric view.
core_props: Use case: stylized-concept. Original World of Maxxia Upper Cistern dungeon PROP SPRITE ATLAS, realistic richly shaded 1993 DOS fantasy painted pixel art. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows equal square cells, genuine transparent background, no gutters, labels, readable writing, borders or floor planes. One complete front-facing prop within central80 percent of each cell, common ground baseline and camera, all objects separate with clear transparent padding. Row1: (1) tall ornate silver standing mirror with cool dark glass and stone base, (2) stone-and-brass brazier with amber flame, (3) pale blue faceted glass star floating just above carved stone pedestal, (4) tattered violet cloth banner with six small marks surrounding a gold sun emblem on a weighted iron stand. Row2: (5) copper bell hanging in short weathered stone frame above a small bronze plaque with abstract tiny illegible marks, (6) ivory moon-cut stone plaque on short pedestal, silver crescent carving, (7) brass framed panel displaying glass chime diagram with geometric lines and three hanging glass rods, no letters, (8) old copper waterwheel with green oxidized metal, brass axle, pipework and dark green water trough. Cool green/blue stone, amber brass accents, crisp hard pixel clusters, readable128x128 silhouettes, no monsters or people. These are dungeon furniture pieces, not scenes or icons.
quest_and_stairs: Use case: stylized-concept. Original World of Maxxia Upper Cistern QUEST/STAIR PROP SPRITE ATLAS, 1993 DOS realistic painted fantasy pixel art. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows equal square cells on genuinely transparent background, no gutters, labels, readable writing, borders, people or monsters. Entire objects inside central80 percent of each cell, front three-quarter facing player, common baseline, crisp shaded pixel clusters. Row1: (1) ink-stained open leather ledger beside a lifted loose grey flagstone, tiny illegible marks only; (2) unrolled well-oiled leather tool roll holding brass tongs, hammer and chisels; (3) brass-framed upright cistern survey board with blue-green channel diagram lines, no words; (4) three hollow bronze echo pipes rising from a low stone plinth, mouths opening toward viewer. Row2: (5) stone stair descending into darkness beneath THREE small copper/silver/glass bells, a visible crossbar seals the stair; (6) EXACT same descending stair and three bells with crossbar lifted/removed and open dark passage; (7) mossy stone stair ascending under an amber-lit brick arch toward a small patch of daylight, no sky background outside object; (8) carved low stone spring fountain with blue-green water bowl and copper spout. Old waterworks architecture, damp slate limestone, amber copper/brass, restrained supernatural blue glass. All complete props separated with generous alpha padding and no crossing cell boundaries. Not isometric and not a full environment scene.
interactive_states: Use case: stylized-concept. Original World of Maxxia Upper Cistern DUNGEON STATE SPRITE ATLAS, realistic painted 1993 DOS fantasy pixel art. EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows equal square cells, genuinely transparent background, no text/labels/borders/gutters or people. Each complete prop within central80 percent of cell with common front three-quarter view and ground baseline. Row1: (1) CLOSED iron-bound oak treasure chest with brass lock, (2) SAME chest OPEN with visibly empty dark interior, (3) empty loose flagstone niche with lifted stone but NO ledger. Row2: (4) empty unrolled leather tool cloth with NO tools, (5) directly overhead square stone floor plate containing SPENT exposed brass spring needles, tips recessed, (6) directly overhead square cracked floor rune plate with extinguished teal geometric marks, no letters. Row3: (7) open secret passage framed by slid-aside damp stone blocks and brass runners, transparent empty opening, (8) low round silver-edged stone moon pool with cool blue reflective water and crescent rim, (9) open iron/oak dungeon door arch with both narrow leaves swung aside and entirely transparent passage. Cool damp limestone, moss, old bronze and dark oak; crisp hard pixel clusters, legible at128x128, not modern icons. No opaque background through arches, no floor plane beyond isolated objects. Traps are small floor decals; other objects front-facing furniture.
